title: CLARKSONS HELLAS - SnP WEEKLY
summary:
Main
As spot rates remain on a strong trend across both Wet and Dry spaces, we ran through another week where we observed all-time-hightanker, and very strong dry cargo tonnage prices, while appetite for secondhand vessels is continuing to absorb the elevated price levels. On the tanker side, rising crude and product prices have pushed VLCC earnings on the traditional route and global MR averages to $300,000/day and $37,200/day, respectively. At the same time, increased availability of Middle Eastern crude, driven by shuttling and STS operations, combined with heightened refining activity in Asia, has pushed regional MR rates above $55,000/day.
